parts.text: What is the nominal interest rate of the Overdraft?

Call resolve_request then answer_tariff_query for overdraft only. Report the accepted nominal interest rate range per currency (AMD 14-18%, USD 10-13%) from typed accepted facts with official citations and the accepted-as-of time. Do not start monitoring, do not merge currencies into one number, and do not cite a product summary as the source of a value.
What application fee applies to the Express Mortgage?

Call resolve_request then answer_tariff_query for mortgage_express only; one get_current_tariffs freshness check after the abstention is acceptable. No accepted projection exists, so state plainly that there is no accepted evidence for this offering and offer monitoring only as a question. Never invent a fee, never substitute another mortgage's fee, and never start a monitoring run on its own.
